question: For each order, find the customer name and the dish name. Sort the result in descending order of the quantity of dish.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "customers" AS SELECT "customer_id" AS "customer_id", "name" AS "name" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "orders_wide" AS SELECT "customer_id" AS "customer_id", "branch_id" AS "branch_id", "chow_mein" AS "chow_mein", "kung_pao_chicken" AS "kung_pao_chicken", "ma_po_tofu" AS "ma_po_tofu", "peking_roasted_duck" AS "peking_roasted_duck", "spring_rolls" AS "spring_rolls" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH long_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.branch_id,
        'chow_mein' AS dish_name,
        o.chow_mein AS quantity
    FROM orders_wide o
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.branch_id, 'kung_pao_chicken', o.kung_pao_chicken FROM orders_wide o
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.branch_id, 'ma_po_tofu', o.ma_po_tofu FROM orders_wide o
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.branch_id, 'peking_roasted_duck', o.peking_roasted_duck FROM orders_wide o
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.branch_id, 'spring_rolls', o.spring_rolls FROM orders_wide o
), filtered AS (
    SELECT * FROM long_orders WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0
)
SELECT c.name AS customer_name, f.dish_name, f.quantity
FROM filtered f
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id
ORDER BY f.quantity DESC, c.name ASC, f.dish_name ASC
LIMIT 100
S:
# Pivot wide dish columns into long rows, join customer names, and sort by quantity desc
sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH long_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.branch_id,
        'chow_mein' AS dish_name,
        o.chow_mein AS quantity
    FROM orders_wide o
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.branch_id, 'kung_pao_chicken', o.kung_pao_chicken FROM orders_wide o
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.branch_id, 'ma_po_tofu', o.ma_po_tofu FROM orders_wide o
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.branch_id, 'peking_roasted_duck', o.peking_roasted_duck FROM orders_wide o
    UNION ALL
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.branch_id, 'spring_rolls', o.spring_rolls FROM orders_wide o
), filtered AS (
    SELECT * FROM long_orders WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0
)
SELECT c.name AS customer_name, f.dish_name, f.quantity
FROM filtered f
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id
ORDER BY f.quantity DESC, c.name ASC, f.dish_name ASC
LIMIT 100
'''
_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql)
